g.text: Tube Screamer style overdrive: mid hump, soft
clipping, tone is a low-pass. Great for pushing
Press : to talk to the tech, ? for keys. Try: "give me an edge-of-break
listened to the last few seconds
Had a listen: the air band was sitting about 5 dB hot and the crest was
low, so the fizz was mostly the cab letting too much through. Closed the cab
down to 4.6k, rolled the Screamer's tone back and took a point off presence.
Then pushed the amp gain up a notch so it sags instead of the pedal doing al
the work. Try leaning into a bend on the G string. u undoes the lot if it's
ask the tech… (e.g. more chime, less mud)
